text:
Alex: FYI scheduling a 02:00 UTC nightly 'soft-swap' across us-west2 racks tomorrow. We'll do staggered node reboots with egress-rate-throttle so tenant traffic doesn't spike.
Maria: What's the window and expected pool capacity loss?
Alex: 02:00-04:00 UTC; cohorts of 8-10 racks every 10m. Expected GPU capacity dip ~6-9% per cohort, total ~18-22% at peak across the region.
JT: We'll scale the burst-pool up and pre-seed KV cache before each cohort to smooth cold-starts. Recommend 2 canary racks first.
Samira: Agree. Rollback criteria: queue latency > 1500ms for >3m OR error-rate increase > 2% sustained for 2m.
Samira: Playbook snippet (for ops runbook):
```
# per-cohort steps
lock-routing --cohort $COHORT
drain-nodes --soft --evict-tasks=false --grace-period=120
throttle-egress --cohort $COHORT --limit 500mbps
preseed-kv --cohort $COHORT --timeout 300
monitor latency_95, error_rate, token_throughput
if latency_95 > 1500ms or error_rate > 2%:
  cancel-cohort --id $COHORT --notify oncall
  rollback-routing --cohort $COHORT
```
Maria: Quick cost note — burst-pool will add transient spend. Please tag maintenance resources with `maintenance=egress-soft-swap` so finance can attribute to infra-maint budget.
Alex: We'll also enable model-fallback to smaller quantized variants for non-critical customer tiers during the cohort to reduce token load.
JT: Can ops get a 30m lead to run the canary? I'd like a smoke run on 2 racks and validate KV hit rate and tail latency.
Alex: Canary scheduled at 01:30 UTC. Proceed only if 95th latency < 300ms and KV hitrate > 85%.
infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: MI-2891 — soft-swap us-west2, 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Owner: alex. Status: scheduled.
Samira: I'll be on-call for the window. @Maria you own customer comms. Use status.redwood.ai if we need public updates; internal #status will be for internal comms.
Maria: Got it — drafting announcement now. Will post to #announcements at 12:00 UTC and send a brief to priority customers with mitigation details.
JT: Abort command if cohort misbehaves:
```
maintenance cancel --ticket MI-2891 --cohort $COHORT --reason "latency spike"
```
Alex: Final preflight checklist: canary pass, burst-pool seeded, tags applied, monitoring dashboards ready, on-call present. If all green we start at 02:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Maria: I'll include cost tagging instructions in the announcement and add a billing note to MI-2891.
Samira: Copy — preflight smoke scheduled 00:50 UTC and I'll post results here.
Alex: Thanks team. Please keep all runbook updates and timeline events in the MI-2891 ticket and paste short notes here for audit.
